reason: It's labelled a concept, not a live product, so I'd be paying a studio I've never met to build something for a till I'd have to explain to my team. I'd want to see it working before I'd sign anything.
objection: Is a remote studio worth it compared to someone local? If something goes wrong with a payment check, I need someone I can call on the same day, not an agency across a border.
would_change_my_mind: A working demo I can test on my own till data, plus a named local partner or a clear same-day support promise.
